articles.title: Breaking News: PM Modi Mourns Nana Patekar’s Demise, Praises His Unmistakable Screen Presence
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has expressed condolences over the reported demise of veteran actor Nana Patekar, remembering his distinctive contribution to Hindi and Marathi cinema. In a post on social media platform X, the Prime Minister highlighted Nana Patekar’s intensity, individuality and unmistakable presence as a performer. PM Modi praised the late actor’s creativity and versatility, noting that his body of work would continue to be remembered by generations of audiences. He also recalled Nana Patekar’s reputation for expressing his views frankly and fearlessly, a quality that became an important part of his public personality. The Prime Minister described Nana Patekar’s contribution to both Hindi and Marathi cinema as immense and said his passing represents a significant loss. He extended his condolences to Nana Patekar’s family, friends and countless admirers. The tribute comes as condolences continue to pour in from political leaders, colleagues and members of the Indian film industry following the actor’s reported death in Goa. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath have also expressed their grief. Nana Patekar was widely recognised for his powerful performances, distinctive dialogue delivery and ability to portray a wide range of characters. His work across Hindi and Marathi cinema earned him a lasting place among India’s acclaimed performers. PM Modi concluded his message by offering condolences to the actor’s loved ones and admirers and paying tribute to his memory with “Om Shanti.”

articles.title: Breaking News: Goa CM Pramod Sawant Mourns Nana Patekar, Promises State Support to Family
articles.description: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant has expressed profound grief over the reported demise of veteran actor Nana Patekar in Goa. Speaking about the tragic incident, Sawant said he was informed that the actor was taken to hospital in the early hours after those close to him discovered that he was unwell. Doctors subsequently declared him dead. Calling Nana Patekar a close personal friend and a distinguished artist of India, the Goa Chief Minister said his passing was a tremendous loss for the country and the film fraternity. Sawant recalled his longstanding association with Nana and said the actor would personally contact him whenever he visited Goa. The two shared a close relationship, with Nana also visiting the Chief Minister’s official residence on several occasions. Sawant highlighted Nana Patekar’s connection with social initiatives and recalled the actor’s interest in expanding social work through the Nana Patekar Foundation in Goa. He also remembered the actor’s lasting contribution to cinema, particularly his acclaimed performances in Krantiveer and the Marathi classic Natsamrat. On arrangements following the reported death, Sawant said he had instructed the state administration to coordinate with Nana Patekar’s family and provide all necessary assistance. Authorities are expected to support the family with arrangements in Goa as the actor’s mortal remains are prepared to be taken back. The Chief Minister’s tribute reflects the widespread grief surrounding the reported loss of one of India’s most respected performers.
